# Tweak reference

<!-- Generated by tools/Frtune.DocGen. Do not edit by hand: run `dotnet run --project tools/Frtune.DocGen > TWEAKS.md`. -->

Every tweak frtune can apply (89 in total), grouped by page, with the exact registry values, services, scheduled tasks, power settings or commands it touches.
Before applying, frtune saves the current value of every target listed here, and turning a tweak off writes those saved values back.

Risk: **Safe** = no known downside · **Moderate** = has a trade-off, read the description · **Advanced** = security or stability trade-off, never part of a preset, asks for confirmation.

Presets: **Gaming** · **Balanced** · **Low-End PC** · **Privacy** · **Max Performance**

## Gaming

### Enable Game Mode

`gaming.gamemode` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, MaxPerformance

Lets Windows prioritise the game you're playing and hold back Windows Update installs and notifications while it runs.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar\AutoGameModeEnabled = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\GameBar\AllowAutoGameMode = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling

`gaming.hags` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance · only: Windows 10 2004+ with an NVIDIA or AMD GPU

Moves GPU work scheduling from the CPU to a scheduler on the GPU. Needs a GPU and driver that support it (NVIDIA GTX 10-series or newer, AMD RX 5000 or newer).

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers\HwSchMode = DWORD 0x2 (2)`

### Disable Xbox Game DVR / Game Bar capture

`gaming.gamedvr` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Stops background recording of gameplay, which costs GPU encoder time and disk writes. Game Bar itself still opens with Win+G.

- `HKCU\System\GameConfigStore\GameDVR_Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR\AppCaptureEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR\AllowGameDVR = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable fullscreen optimizations (global)

`gaming.fso` · **Moderate** · presets: MaxPerformance

Makes exclusive-fullscreen games run in true exclusive fullscreen instead of Windows' optimised borderless mode. Can help older DX9/DX11 games; can break Alt-Tab overlays in some titles.

- `HKCU\System\GameConfigStore\GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode = DWORD 0x2 (2)`
- `HKCU\System\GameConfigStore\GameDVR_FSEBehavior = DWORD 0x2 (2)`
- `HKCU\System\GameConfigStore\GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKCU\System\GameConfigStore\GameDVR_DXGIHonorFSEWindowsCompatible = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Multimedia scheduler: prioritise games

`gaming.mmcss` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Tunes MMCSS: reserves only 10% CPU for background tasks (default 20%) and raises the CPU and GPU priority of the "Games" task class.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\SystemResponsiveness = DWORD 0xA (10)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\GPU Priority = DWORD 0x8 (8)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\Priority = DWORD 0x6 (6)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\Scheduling Category = SZ "High"`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games\SFIO Priority = SZ "High"`

### Foreground boost (Win32PrioritySeparation)

`gaming.priosep` · **Moderate** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Sets Win32PrioritySeparation to 0x26: short, variable quanta with a 3x boost for the foreground app. This favours the game window over background work.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl\Win32PrioritySeparation = DWORD 0x26 (38)`

### Optimizations for windowed games

`gaming.windowed` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, MaxPerformance · only: Windows 11 only

Windows 11 setting that upgrades DX10/11 games running in a window or borderless to the flip presentation model: lower latency and Auto HDR/VRR support.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences\DirectXUserGlobalSettings: set entry SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1`

### Disable the Windows VRR override

`gaming.vrr` · **Moderate** · only: Windows 10 1903+

Turns off "Variable refresh rate" in Graphics settings, which forces VRR on for DX11 games that don't support it themselves. Only turn this off if a game stutters or flickers with VRR.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences\DirectXUserGlobalSettings: set entry VRROptimizeEnable=0`

### Global timer resolution requests

`gaming.timerres` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: MaxPerformance · only: Windows 10 2004+

Since Windows 10 2004, one app raising the timer resolution no longer affects others. This restores the old global behaviour so a game's 0.5–1 ms timer request applies system-wide. Higher idle power use.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\kernel\GlobalTimerResolutionRequests = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

## Performance

### Ultimate Performance power plan

`perf.ultimateplan` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance · only: Desktops only

Activates the hidden Ultimate Performance plan (creates it from Windows' template if needed). It removes micro power-saving delays. Desktops only: on a laptop it drains the battery.

- `powercfg /setactive e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61 (or /duplicatescheme it first if it's hidden)`

### Disable CPU core parking

`perf.coreparking` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Keeps all cores unparked in the active power plan (CPMINCORES = 100%), so the CPU doesn't wake parked cores at the start of a load spike.

- `Active power plan: Processor performance core parking min cores → 100 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100]`

### Disable power throttling

`perf.powerthrottling` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance · only: Windows 10 1709+

Stops Windows from running background apps on efficient (slower) CPU states to save power.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling\PowerThrottlingOff = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable SysMain (Superfetch)

`perf.sysmain` · **Moderate** · presets: LowEnd, MaxPerformance · only: SSD system drives only

Stops SysMain from pre-loading apps into RAM. On an SSD the benefit is small and it costs disk and CPU time in the background.

- `Service SysMain: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Windows Search indexing

`perf.search` · **Moderate** · presets: LowEnd

Stops the indexer service. Start-menu and Explorer search still work, but slower and without file contents.

- `Service WSearch: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Fast Startup

`perf.faststartup` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Makes Shut down a real shutdown instead of a hibernated kernel. Fixes driver and uptime oddities; cold boots take a little longer.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power\HiberbootEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable hibernation

`perf.hibernate` · **Moderate** · presets: LowEnd · only: Desktops only (laptops rely on hibernate when the battery runs low)

Runs powercfg /hibernate off. Deletes hiberfil.sys (several GB on C:). Also turns off Fast Startup.

- `powercfg /hibernate off  (HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\HibernateEnabled → 0)`

### Disable memory compression

`perf.memcompression` · **Advanced** · needs: Reboot

Turns off the compressed memory store (Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression). Saves a little CPU but pages to disk sooner. Only worth it with plenty of RAM.

- `Disable-MMAgent -MemoryCompression`

### NTFS: stop updating last-access times

`perf.ntfslastaccess` · **Safe** · needs: Reboot · presets: Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Stops NTFS writing a timestamp every time a file is read. Fewer disk writes.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem\NtfsDisableLastAccessUpdate = DWORD 0x80000001 (2147483649)`

### NTFS: stop creating 8.3 short names

`perf.ntfs83` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: MaxPerformance

Stops creating legacy DOS short names (PROGRA~1) for new files on all volumes. Very old 16-bit installers may need them.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem\NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Make sure TRIM and scheduled optimisation are on

`perf.trim` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance · only: SSD system drives only

Turns on TRIM notifications and the weekly ScheduledDefrag task (which runs TRIM on SSDs, not defrag). These are Windows defaults; this repairs them if something turned them off.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem\DisableDeleteNotification = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Defrag\ScheduledDefrag → enabled`

### Group service hosts by RAM size

`perf.svchostsplit` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: LowEnd

Sets SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB to your RAM size. Windows then groups services into fewer svchost.exe processes: less overhead, but one crash can take several services down.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB = your RAM size in KB`

### Disable background apps

`perf.backgroundapps` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance

Stops Store apps running in the background (mail sync, live tiles, etc.). Desktop programs aren't affected.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\BackgroundAccessApplications\GlobalUserDisabled = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy\LetAppsRunInBackground = DWORD 0x2 (2)`

### Disable tips, suggestions and Spotlight ads

`perf.tips` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance

Turns off Start suggestions, "tips and tricks" notifications, Settings suggestions and lock-screen Spotlight ads.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SubscribedContent-338388Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SubscribedContent-338389Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SubscribedContent-338393Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SubscribedContent-353694Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SubscribedContent-353696Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SoftLandingEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\RotatingLockScreenOverlayEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

## Network

### TCP tuning for low latency

`net.tcpglobal` · **Moderate** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Receive-window auto-tuning = normal, Receive Side Scaling on (spreads network work across cores), Receive Segment Coalescing off (lower per-packet latency), TCP timestamps off.

- `Receive window auto-tuning → Normal  [netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal]`
- `Receive Side Scaling → Enabled  [netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled]`
- `Receive Segment Coalescing → Disabled  [netsh int tcp set global rsc=disabled]`
- `TCP timestamps → Disabled  [netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled]`

### Disable ECN

`net.ecn` · **Moderate**

Turns off Explicit Congestion Notification. A few routers and games handle ECN-marked packets badly; on most networks this makes no difference.

- `ECN capability → Disabled  [netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled]`

### Use CTCP congestion control

`net.ctcp` · **Moderate** · presets: MaxPerformance

Switches the Internet TCP template from CUBIC to Compound TCP. Can ramp up faster on high-latency links; on a normal home connection the difference is small.

- `Congestion provider → CTCP  [netsh int tcp set supplemental template=internet congestionprovider=ctcp]`

### Disable Nagle's algorithm (active adapters)

`net.nagle` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on every adapter that has an IP address, so small game packets are sent and acknowledged immediately instead of batched.

- Plus one entry per network adapter found on the PC (see description).

### Remove network throttling

`net.throttling` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex to 0xFFFFFFFF. By default Windows limits non-multimedia network packet processing while media is playing.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\NetworkThrottlingIndex = DWORD 0xFFFFFFFF (4294967295)`

### Disable QoS reserved bandwidth

`net.qos` · **Safe** · presets: MaxPerformance

Sets the Packet Scheduler's NonBestEffortLimit policy to 0%. Honest note: Windows only reserves bandwidth when an app asks for QoS, so most PCs see no change.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched\NonBestEffortLimit = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable network adapter power saving

`net.adapterpower` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Unticks "Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power" on every physical network adapter (PnPCapabilities = 0x18). Prevents the adapter dozing between packets.

- Plus one entry per network adapter found on the PC (see description).

### Prefer IPv4 over IPv6

`net.preferipv4` · **Moderate** · needs: Reboot

Sets DisabledComponents = 0x20, Microsoft's supported way to prefer IPv4 without disabling IPv6 (fully disabling IPv6 breaks parts of Windows).

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters\DisabledComponents = DWORD 0x20 (32)`

### Disable Teredo tunnelling

`net.teredo` · **Moderate**

Turns off the Teredo IPv6-over-IPv4 tunnel. Note: Xbox party chat on PC uses Teredo, so leave it on if you use that.

- `netsh interface teredo set state disabled`

### Disable Wi-Fi Sense hotspot sharing

`net.wifisense` · **Safe** · presets: Balanced, Privacy · only: PCs with Wi-Fi

Stops automatic connection to suggested open hotspots and hotspot reporting.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\PolicyManager\default\WiFi\AllowWiFiHotSpotReporting\value = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\PolicyManager\default\WiFi\AllowAutoConnectToWiFiSenseHotspots\value = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable Delivery Optimization peer sharing

`net.deliveryopt` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance

Windows Update downloads only from Microsoft (DODownloadMode = 0) and stops uploading updates to other PCs from your connection.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization\DODownloadMode = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

## Privacy

### Minimum telemetry

`privacy.telemetry` · **Safe** · presets: LowEnd, Privacy

Disables the Connected User Experiences (DiagTrack) and WAP push (dmwappushservice) services and sets AllowTelemetry to the lowest level your edition honours: 0 (Security) on Enterprise/Education, 1 (Required) on Home/Pro.

- `Service DiagTrack: startup type → Disabled`
- `Service dmwappushservice: startup type → Disabled`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection\AllowTelemetry = 0 on Enterprise/Education, otherwise 1`

### Disable advertising ID

`privacy.adid` · **Safe** · presets: Balanced, Privacy

Stops apps using your advertising ID for personalised ads.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo\Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AdvertisingInfo\DisabledByGroupPolicy = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable activity history

`privacy.activity` · **Safe** · presets: Privacy

Stops Windows collecting and uploading the list of apps, files and sites you used (Timeline / "Recommended").

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\EnableActivityFeed = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\PublishUserActivities = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\UploadUserActivities = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable tailored experiences

`privacy.tailored` · **Safe** · presets: Balanced, Privacy

Stops Microsoft using diagnostic data to show you personalised tips, ads and recommendations.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy\TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable Cortana, Bing and web results in Start

`privacy.websearch` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: LowEnd, Privacy

Start search shows only local results. Disables Cortana by policy.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search\AllowCortana = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search\DisableWebSearch = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search\ConnectedSearchUseWeb = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search\BingSearchEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\DisableSearchBoxSuggestions = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable Windows Recall

`privacy.recall` · **Safe** · presets: Privacy · only: Windows 11 24H2+

Turns off Recall snapshots (AI analysis of your screen) by policy, for the current user and machine-wide.

- `HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI\DisableAIDataAnalysis = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI\DisableAIDataAnalysis = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable Copilot

`privacy.copilot` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: LowEnd, Privacy · only: Windows 11 only

Turns off Windows Copilot by policy and hides its taskbar button.

- `HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot\TurnOffWindowsCopilot = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ShowCopilotButton = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable location services

`privacy.location` · **Moderate** · presets: Privacy · only: Hidden on laptops (Find my device relies on it)

Turns off Windows location for all apps by policy. Weather, Maps and "Find my device" won't know where you are.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\LocationAndSensors\DisableLocation = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable feedback prompts and the Diagnostic Data Viewer

`privacy.feedback` · **Safe** · presets: Balanced, Privacy

Windows stops asking for feedback, and the Diagnostic Data Viewer is turned off.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules\NumberOfSIUFInPeriod = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection\DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection\DisableDiagnosticDataViewer = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Disable app launch tracking

`privacy.applaunch` · **Safe** · presets: Privacy

Stops Windows tracking which apps you launch to personalise Start and search.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\Start_TrackProgs = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable clipboard sync across devices

`privacy.clipboardsync` · **Safe** · presets: Privacy

Clipboard history stays on this PC; it is no longer synced through your Microsoft account.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System\AllowCrossDeviceClipboard = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable telemetry scheduled tasks

`privacy.tasks` · **Safe** · presets: Privacy

Disables these tasks: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser, ProgramDataUpdater, Proxy, Consolidator, UsbCeip, Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector, DmClient, DmClientOnScenarioDownload. Tasks that don't exist on this PC are skipped.

- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient → disabled`
- `Scheduled task \Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClientOnScenarioDownload → disabled`

## Debloat

### Stop auto-installing suggested apps

`debloat.consumer` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance

Turns off Windows consumer features and silent app installs, so removed apps (Candy Crush, TikTok…) aren't reinstalled. The policy value only works on Enterprise/Education; the per-user values work on every edition.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent\DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\SilentInstalledAppsEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\PreInstalledAppsEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager\ContentDeliveryAllowed = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable Widgets and the news feed

`debloat.widgets11` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance · only: Windows 11 only

Turns off the Widgets board (news and interests) by policy.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh\AllowNewsAndInterests = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable News and Interests on the taskbar

`debloat.news10` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance · only: Windows 10 only

Removes the weather/news widget from the Windows 10 taskbar by policy.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Feeds\EnableFeeds = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Quiet Microsoft Edge

`debloat.edge` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Edge policies: no first-run wizard, no "make Edge default" nags, no Startup Boost and no running in the background after you close it. Edge itself keeps working.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\HideFirstRunExperience = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\DefaultBrowserSettingEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\StartupBoostEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\BackgroundModeEnabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable OneDrive sync

`debloat.onedrive` · **Moderate** · needs: SignOut

Stops OneDrive syncing by policy (DisableFileSyncNGSC). It doesn't uninstall it or touch your files. To fully remove OneDrive, use the uninstall button on this page.

> **Warning:** Files that only exist in OneDrive ("online-only") will no longer be reachable from File Explorer until you turn this back off.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OneDrive\DisableFileSyncNGSC = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

## Services

### Disable Print Spooler

`svc.spooler` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, MaxPerformance · only: Only when no physical printer is installed

No printer was detected. The spooler has a history of security bugs (PrintNightmare). Turn it back on before adding a printer.

- `Service Spooler: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Fax

`svc.fax` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

The Fax service. Nobody needs it on a home PC.

- `Service Fax: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Remote Registry

`svc.remoteregistry` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, Privacy, MaxPerformance

Stops other computers editing this PC's registry over the network.

- `Service RemoteRegistry: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Bluetooth support

`svc.bluetooth` · **Safe** · only: Only when no Bluetooth adapter is present

No Bluetooth adapter was detected, so the Bluetooth Support Service has nothing to do.

- `Service bthserv: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Retail Demo

`svc.retaildemo` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Only used on store display machines.

- `Service RetailDemo: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Downloaded Maps Manager

`svc.maps` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Only the Maps app uses it.

- `Service MapsBroker: startup type → Disabled`

### Disable Geolocation service

`svc.geolocation` · **Moderate** · presets: Privacy · only: Hidden on laptops

Apps can no longer get your location. Weather and Maps fall back to manual locations.

- `Service lfsvc: startup type → Disabled`

### Set Error Reporting to manual

`svc.wer` · **Safe** · presets: LowEnd, Privacy

Windows Error Reporting starts only when a crash happens instead of idling in the background.

- `Service WerSvc: startup type → Manual`

### Set Phone Service to manual

`svc.phone` · **Safe** · presets: LowEnd

Telephony state for Phone Link. Starts on demand instead of at boot.

- `Service PhoneSvc: startup type → Manual`

### Disable touch keyboard and handwriting

`svc.tablet` · **Moderate** · only: Desktops only

Not needed on a desktop without a touch screen or pen.

- `Service TabletInputService: startup type → Disabled`

## Input

### Disable mouse acceleration (1:1 MarkC fix)

`input.mouseaccel` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Turns off "Enhance pointer precision", sets pointer speed to 10/20 (6/11, no multiplier) and installs the MarkC 1:1 curve for 100% scaling, so movement is raw even if a game re-enables acceleration. Takes effect after you sign out.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseSpeed = SZ "0"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseThreshold1 = SZ "0"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseThreshold2 = SZ "0"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseSensitivity = SZ "10"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\SmoothMouseXCurve = BINARY 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 C0 CC 0C 00 00 00 00 00 80 99 19 00 00 00 00 00 40 66 26 00 00 00 00 00 00 33 33 00 00 00 00 00`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\SmoothMouseYCurve = BINARY 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 38 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 70 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 A8 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 E0 00 00 00 00 00`

### Fastest keyboard repeat

`input.keyboard` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Shortest delay before a held key repeats (0) and the fastest repeat rate (31). Windows has no setting for keyboard polling rate; that's set by the keyboard's firmware.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Keyboard\KeyboardDelay = SZ "0"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Keyboard\KeyboardSpeed = SZ "31"`

### Disable Sticky/Filter/Toggle Keys shortcuts

`input.accessibility` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, MaxPerformance

Pressing Shift five times or holding it in a game no longer pops up the accessibility prompts. The features themselves still work from Settings.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys\Flags = SZ "506"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response\Flags = SZ "122"`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys\Flags = SZ "58"`

### Smaller mouse and keyboard input buffers

`input.queue` · **Advanced** · needs: Reboot

Sets the mouclass/kbdclass data queue sizes to 20 (default 100). A popular latency tweak with no measured benefit; included for completeness. Very fast polling mice (4–8 kHz) can drop input with a small queue.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\mouclass\Parameters\MouseDataQueueSize = DWORD 0x14 (20)`
- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\kbdclass\Parameters\KeyboardDataQueueSize = DWORD 0x14 (20)`

### Faster hover response

`input.hover` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: MaxPerformance

Lowers the hover delay (MouseHoverTime) from 400 ms to 10 ms, so tooltips and taskbar previews react instantly.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Mouse\MouseHoverTime = SZ "10"`

## Power

### Disable USB selective suspend

`power.usbsuspend` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

USB devices (mouse, keyboard, headset, Wi-Fi dongle) are never put to sleep to save power. Avoids wake-up lag and dropouts.

- `Active power plan: USB selective suspend → 0 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 2a737441-1930-4402-8d77-b2bebba308a3 48e6b7a6-50f5-4782-a5d4-53bb8f07e226 0]`

### Disable PCIe link state power management

`power.aspm` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance · only: Desktops only

Keeps the PCIe links to your GPU and NVMe drive at full power. Slightly higher idle draw.

- `Active power plan: PCI Express link state power management → 0 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 501a4d13-42af-4429-9fd1-a8218c268e20 ee12f906-d277-404b-b6da-e5fa1a576df5 0]`

### Never turn off hard disks

`power.disksleep` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance · only: Desktops only

Disk idle timeout = 0 (never). Prevents spin-up stutter on HDDs; harmless on SSDs.

- `Active power plan: Turn off hard disk after (seconds) → 0 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 0012ee47-9041-4b5d-9b77-535fba8b1442 6738e2c4-e8a5-4a42-b16a-e040e769756e 0]`

### Minimum processor state 100%

`power.minstate` · **Moderate** · presets: MaxPerformance · only: Desktops only

The CPU never drops below base clock while plugged in. Removes the ramp-up delay, but idles warmer and uses more power.

- `Active power plan: Minimum processor state (%) → 100 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 893dee8e-2bef-41e0-89c6-b55d0929964c 100]`

### Maximum processor state 100%

`power.maxstate` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, Balanced, MaxPerformance

Makes sure the CPU is allowed to reach full speed (some OEM plans cap it at 99%, which also disables turbo).

- `Active power plan: Maximum processor state (%) → 100 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 bc5038f7-23e0-4960-96da-33abaf5935ec 100]`

### Aggressive turbo boost

`power.boost` · **Safe** · presets: Gaming, MaxPerformance

Processor performance boost mode = Aggressive (2): the CPU turbos whenever it can.

- `Active power plan: Processor performance boost mode → 2 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 be337238-0d82-4146-a960-4f3749d470c7 2]`

### Energy performance preference: max performance

`power.epp` · **Moderate** · presets: MaxPerformance

EPP = 0 tells the CPU's own power manager to favour performance over efficiency. Has an effect on CPUs with Speed Shift (Intel 6th gen+, Ryzen with CPPC).

- `Active power plan: Processor energy performance preference (%) → 0 (plugged in)  [powercfg /setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 36687f9e-e3a5-4dbf-b1dc-15eb381c6863 0]`

## Visuals

### Visual effects: best performance (keep smooth fonts)

`visuals.performance` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: LowEnd

Same as "Adjust for best performance" in System Properties, but keeps font smoothing and thumbnails. Sets VisualFXSetting = 3 (custom) and UserPreferencesMask = 90 12 03 80 10 00 00 00.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects\VisualFXSetting = DWORD 0x3 (3)`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\UserPreferencesMask = BINARY 90 12 03 80 10 00 00 00`
- `HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\FontSmoothing = SZ "2"`

### Disable transparency

`visuals.transparency` · **Safe** · presets: LowEnd, MaxPerformance

Turns off the acrylic/mica transparency on the taskbar, Start and window frames.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize\EnableTransparency = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable window and taskbar animations

`visuals.animations` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: LowEnd, MaxPerformance

No minimise/maximise animation and no taskbar animations. Windows feel snappier.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics\MinAnimate = SZ "0"`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\TaskbarAnimations = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM\EnableAeroPeek = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Disable shadows and translucent selection

`visuals.shadows` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: LowEnd

Removes icon-label shadows on the desktop and the translucent selection rectangle.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ListviewShadow = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ListviewAlphaSelect = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Faster menus

`visuals.menudelay` · **Safe** · needs: SignOut · presets: Gaming, Balanced, LowEnd, MaxPerformance

MenuShowDelay 400 → 50 ms: cascading menus open almost immediately.

- `HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop\MenuShowDelay = SZ "50"`

### Classic right-click menu

`visuals.classicmenu` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: Balanced · only: Windows 11 only

Windows 11 shows the full context menu straight away instead of "Show more options". Works by registering an empty InprocServer32 for the new menu's CLSID; revert removes the key.

- `HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-34aa-4e8b-a509-50c905bae2a2}\InprocServer32\(Default) = SZ ""`

### Show file extensions

`visuals.extensions` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: Balanced, Privacy

Shows .exe, .pdf and so on in File Explorer. It's also safer: you can spot "invoice.pdf.exe".

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\HideFileExt = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Show hidden files

`visuals.hidden` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart

Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer (protected system files stay hidden).

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\Hidden = DWORD 0x1 (1)`

### Open File Explorer to This PC

`visuals.thispc` · **Safe** · needs: ExplorerRestart · presets: Privacy

File Explorer opens on This PC instead of Quick Access/Home, and stops listing recent and frequent files there.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\LaunchTo = DWORD 0x1 (1)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\ShowRecent = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\ShowFrequent = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Dark mode

`visuals.darkmode` · **Safe**

Dark theme for apps and for Windows itself (taskbar, Start).

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize\AppsUseLightTheme = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize\SystemUsesLightTheme = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Left-align the taskbar

`visuals.taskbarleft` · **Safe** · only: Windows 11 only

Moves the Windows 11 Start button and taskbar icons to the left like Windows 10.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\TaskbarAl = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Hide the Task View button

`visuals.taskview` · **Safe**

Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Win+Tab still works.

- `HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced\ShowTaskViewButton = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

## Advanced

### Disable Spectre/Meltdown mitigations

`adv.spectre` · **Advanced** · needs: Reboot

Sets FeatureSettingsOverride/Mask = 3, which turns off the kernel's CPU side-channel mitigations. Gains are a few percent at best on recent CPUs.

> **Warning:** This removes protection against CPU side-channel attacks. Malicious code, including JavaScript in a browser, could read memory belonging to other programs, such as passwords. Microsoft does not recommend this on any PC that browses the web.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\FeatureSettingsOverride = DWORD 0x3 (3)`
- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\FeatureSettingsOverrideMask = DWORD 0x3 (3)`

### Pause Windows Update

`adv.pauseupdates` · **Advanced**

Pauses quality and feature updates for the number of days set in Settings (default 7, maximum 35). This uses Windows' own pause feature, so updates resume automatically afterwards. frtune never fully disables Windows Update.

> **Warning:** While paused you won't get security fixes. Keep the pause short.

- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseUpdatesExpiryTime = today + N days (ISO 8601)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime = now (ISO 8601)`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseFeatureUpdatesEndTime = today + N days`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseQualityUpdatesStartTime = now`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseQualityUpdatesEndTime = today + N days`
- `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings\PauseUpdatesStartTime = now`

### Disable Memory Integrity (HVCI) and VBS

`adv.vbs` · **Advanced** · needs: Reboot

Turns off Virtualization-Based Security and Hypervisor-enforced Code Integrity. Can recover around 5% in some CPU-bound games.

> **Warning:** Memory Integrity stops malicious or vulnerable drivers from tampering with the Windows kernel. Some anti-cheat systems and work/school policies expect it to be on. Without it, kernel-level malware is easier to install.

- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity\Enabled = DWORD 0x0 (0)`
- `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity = DWORD 0x0 (0)`

### Pause Defender real-time protection (temporary)

`adv.defender` · **Advanced**

Runs Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true. Defender turns real-time protection back on by itself after a short time or a restart. Tamper Protection must be off in Windows Security, or Windows will refuse.

> **Warning:** Your PC has no real-time malware protection until Defender re-enables itself. Don't download or run anything while it's paused.

- `Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true`
